subject: Error message in measurement invariance procedure

messages.author: d2bffd1a5d780ca8
messages.subject: Error message in measurement invariance procedure
parts:
Hello guys,

I hope you are very well.

I am trying to evaluate measurement invariance for a psychological scale, but I receive an error message. The instrument is a seven-point Likert scale and the dataset consists of 1721 subjects. In addition, the data are not normally distributed; therefore, I chose MLM as estimator. I want to test if the scale is invariant by gender, hence, the variable "sex" has set to include only two categories (1 = males, 2 = females). I already check for errors in the dataset, but none was found. Here is the code and the error message I get:

sex.syntax.config <- measEq.syntax(configural.model = mymodel, data = mydata, parameterization = "delta", ID.fac = "UL", group = "sex")

 

sex.syntax.metric <- measEq.syntax(configural.model = mymodel, data = mydata, parameterization = "delta", ID.fac = "UL", group = "sex", group.equal = "loadings")

 

sex.syntax.scalar <- measEq.syntax(configural.model = mymodel, data = mydata, parameterization = "delta", ID.fac = "UL", group = "sex", group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"))

 

sex.model.config <- as.character(sex.syntax.config)

sex.model.metric <- as.character(sex.syntax.metric)

sex.model.scalar <- as.character(sex.syntax.scalar)

 

cat(sex.model.config)

cat(sex.model.metric)

cat(sex.model.scalar)

 

sex.fit.config <- cfa(sex.model.config, data = mydata, estimator = "MLM", parameterization = "delta")

sex.fit.config <- cfa(sex.model.metric, data = mydata, estimator = "MLM", parameterization = "delta")

sex.fit.config <- cfa(sex.model.scalar, data = mydata, estimator = "MLM", parameterization = "delta")

 

Error in lavaanify(model = FLAT, constraints = constraints, varTable = lavdata@ov,: lavaan ERROR: wrong number of arguments in modifier (lambda.1_1.g1,lambda.1_1.g2) of element F1=~b1.

I would really appreciate your help. Thanks in advance.

Best regards.

messages.subject: Re: Error message in measurement invariance procedure
parts:
Ok, the problem was more basic. You dont need the delta argument, it is only for categorical data.

The porblem is that you created syntax for multiple groups but didnt specify group in the cfa function. You can use either the MLM or MLR estimators for robust SE and fit indices. You can use AIC and those for non-nested model comparison. But these models are nested, you can use the LRT methods too. You can use the compare function from semTools to show chi-square and other fit indices.
Also, for non nested models you can use the nonnest2 package

sex.fit.config <- cfa(sex.model.config, data = mydata, estimator = "MLM",  group="sex", missing="fiml")

sex.fit.config <- cfa(sex.model.metric, data = mydata, estimator = "MLM",  group="sex" , missing="fiml" )

sex.fit.config <- cfa(sex.model.scalar, data = mydata, estimator = "MLM",  group="sex" , missing="fiml" )
